I implemented phase-08 (US6 Adjust settings) and set it to `ready_for_test`. The build passes with no errors or warnings, but the testing loop hasn't checked anything yet.

- **Before coding:** copied T046 and T047 from `phase-08.md` into `tasks.md` Phase 8. I then regenerated the API client, which added `SettingsService`, `Settings` and `DefaultPage`.
- **T040:** the generated service names, method signatures and models match the ui-contract Settings section. I also checked Angular's route validation: a route with a `canActivate` guard and `children: []` is valid. The findings are written up in `research.md` R-2.
- **T041, Settings page** (`frontend/src/app/pages/settings/settings.page.ts`): it shows display name, plan-start notifications, default page and the read-only time zone. Save sends all three settings together and shows "Settings saved". Server errors show under the field they belong to, and Save is disabled while a save is running.
- **T042, default page** (`frontend/src/app/core/default-page.guard.ts`, `app.routes.ts`): opening `/` reads the settings each time and goes to the chosen page. If the read fails, it opens the Dashboard and shows "Could not load settings". Unknown URLs are sent to `/`, so they land on the default page too.
- **T046, greeting** (`dashboard.page.ts`): the Dashboard greeting now uses the saved display name. If the name is blank or the read fails, it says "Hello".
- **T047, notifications** (`plan-start-watcher.service.ts`): the notifications setting is read right before each plan-start notice. If the read fails, notices stay on.

All five tasks are marked `[~]` in `phase-08.md` and `tasks.json` and `[X]` in `tasks.md`. The build log is in `loops/frontend-dev/runs/001-quickflow/phase-08-build.log`, and each step is logged in `progress.md`.
